name: Hydropower
principle: Water driven through turbines at a dam or run-of-river site generates power; reservoirs add storage. NREL's 2024 baseline gives new-stream-reach development costs of $6,574 to $8,611/kW and non-powered-dam costs of $3,045 to $20,043/kW, with capacity factors of 0.33 to 0.67.
